title: SEC2.2: watch.rs SSE frame accumulation allocates String per line
description:
SSE frame loop on lines 310-386 of watch.rs accumulates frame lines in Vec<String>. Line 384 calls trimmed.to_owned() for every line received, and line 328 calls frame_lines.join() on every complete frame. Additional allocations via format!() on lines 261, 494.

Impact: High allocation pressure in a long-running async task; frequent GC during message notifications.
Fix: Use string slices (Cow<str>) or reuse a buffer instead of allocating per line.
Location: watch.rs lines 310-386 (frame loop), lines 257-269 (request building).
